prompt: Preserve every existing track, clip, region and setting. At 120 BPM, add two regular tracks named Routing Proof A and Routing Proof B with Init sine synths and fader volumes 0.4 and 0.3. On each create one four-beat MIDI clip named Tone A and Tone B respectively: one note starting at beat 0, duration 4, velocity 0.5, pitch 60 for A and 67 for B. Place both in Arrangement at beat 0 for four beats. Create an empty regular audio track named Routing Bus with volume 1, no instrument and no clips. Add one Utility with gain -6 dB to Routing Bus. Route both proof tracks into Routing Bus, and Routing Bus to Master. Show Arrangement and Routing Bus devices, then export only Routing Bus as a 44.1 kHz 32-bit float WAV of Arrangement beats 0 through 4, with no effect tail, normalization or dither. Keep playback stopped.

capabilities.command: {name:select|show_panel|play|pause|stop|seek|launch_scene|launch_clip|stop_track|stop_clips|view|save_project|export_wav|export_stems|export_midi,args?:{beat?,scene? (zero-based),trackId?,view?:session|arrangement,source?:auto|session|arrangement,sampleRate?:44100|48000|88200|96000,bitDepth?:16|24|32 (32=float),normalize?:boolean,dither?:none|triangular (none for float),includeTail?:boolean,range?:{start,length} (zero-based Arrangement beats),channel?:master|track:ID|return:ID (WAV only)}} runtime operation; select uses its own args {target:track,trackId} to show track/return devices (preserving clip content selection), {target:clip,trackId,scene? (zero-based),clipId?} for a Session clip, or {target:regions,ids:[REGION IDs],primaryId?} for Arrangement selection. Clip selection needs either scene or clipId; repeated slots need explicit scene. Region selection reveals the selected range and its primary clip editor. show_panel uses {panel:clip|devices|recording|returns}. These are view changes, not project edits or playback. Region creation supports ref aliases for later selection; ids/primaryId resolve those aliases. launch_clip presses a trigger/toggle Session slot; launch_scene and clip stops wait for quantized activation. Gate/repeat clip holds remain manual. Session export snapshots active clips from their beginnings for four bars, excluding Arrangement automation; auto prefers Arrangement. Defaults: 44.1 kHz/24-bit, no normalization/dither, tails included. Range forces Arrangement and cannot combine with Session source. export_stems downloads an aligned ZIP of all tracks and returns before the master bus; each file obeys mute/solo, crossfade and independent normalization/dither. Channel selection is WAV-only. export_midi uses its own args: source clip or arrangement (default arrangement), clipId for a full clip loop, optional owning trackId for clip effects, trackIds for chosen Arrangement tracks, range for Arrangement only, applyEffects boolean (default false). MIDI ignores mixer mute/solo and excludes audio, instruments, audio effects and automation. A processed shared clip requires an explicit owning trackId. Do not pass audio encoding/rate/tail settings to MIDI. Combine up to eight after project edits, or stop/pause before edits
capabilities.region_crossfade: {leftId,rightId (ordered audio Arrangement REGION IDs on same track),action?:create|remove,start?,length?,boundary?} create/resize a complementary linear crossfade over zero-based start/length; for adjacent clips the overlap must cover their join. Extends outgoing audio to start+length and starts incoming audio at start, preserving source phase and outer boundaries. Requires unused source material inside loop boundaries, no other overlapping fades. Remove joins at boundary (default overlap midpoint), clears the paired fades, and preserves outer edges. Invalid requests reject atomically
capabilities.region_fades: {ids:[existing Arrangement REGION IDs],fadeIn? (beats),fadeOut? (beats)} set audio/generated-loop region edge fades. Durations are independent, 0..each region length; 0 clears an edge. Linear fades cannot overlap each other or cross source-loop boundaries; values outside those bounds reject atomically. Excludes MIDI. Does not change source clips, source offsets, mixer automation or Session playback; one atomic Undo. Split/time-cropped fades retain original gain segments; setting a duration resets that edge to a full 0-to-1 or 1-to-0 fade
capabilities.track: {id,changes:{name?,volume?(linear 0..1),pan?(-1..1),mute?,solo?,output?:master|sendsOnly|track:ID (regular destination input after source effects/fader/pan; accepts track:$alias)}} regular buses support Solo; returns support name/volume/pan/mute, but not Solo or redirected main outputs
capabilities.add_track: {name,ref? (unique $alias for subsequent actions),preset? (Init|Warm bass|Soft pad|Bright pluck),volume? (linear 0..1; use 1 for a unity bus),pan? (-1..1),output?:master|sendsOnly|track:ID} omit preset for an empty audio bus; initial mix values are direct args, not changes
capabilities.manage_track: {id,action:rename|color|move|duplicate|delete,value?} for structural edits; action:changes with {id,action:changes,changes:{name?,volume?,pan?,mute?,solo?,output?}} uses the same validated patch as type track
capabilities.device: {trackId,type?,deviceId?,remove?,enabled?,params?} add/update/remove an effect on a track or return
capabilities.instrument: {trackId,preset?,kind?:poly|drums|sampler,sampleClipId?,params?} presets for poly; sampler copies audio from an existing clip
capabilities.add_return: {name,ref?} create a return with wet reverb
capabilities.midi_effects: {trackId,effectsJSON:JSON-encoded array of complete MIDI effect objects from session}
capabilities.midi: {ref?,clipId?,trackId?,scene?,name? (display name: include any exact user-provided clip name),beats,notes:[{pitch,start,duration,velocity}]} replaces notes or creates MIDI clip
capabilities.region_group: {ids:[existing Arrangement region IDs],action:move|duplicate|delete|active|trim,delta? (beats),trackOffset? (move/duplicate only),edge?:start|end (trim only)} trim moves all chosen starts or ends by one shared quarter-beat-snapped delta; positive moves right, negative left. Shorten starts by 1 beat: edge=start,delta=+1. Shorten ends by 1 beat: edge=end,delta=-1. Negative start delta extends earlier; positive end delta extends later. Starts preserve original ends and source timing. Clamp together at timeline/minimum length boundaries, reject overlaps atomically. Does not alter source clips or track automation
capabilities.region: {id?,ref? (unique alias for a NEW region),trackId?,clipId?,start?,length?,offset?,active?,remove?} add/update/delete Arrangement clip
capabilities.time: {operation:insert|delete|duplicate,start,length,trackIds?} beats are zero-based; omit trackIds for whole song

plan.summary: Added two tracks with MIDI clips, one bus with a Utility device, and routed tracks. Exported Routing Bus as WAV.
